title: Sales totals by region
objective: Total sales for one region from a sales list with SUMIF and a criteria cell, then check the overall total.
instructions: The sales list is in A1:C11. In F2:F4, use SUMIF to total the Sales (K) for the region named in E2:E4. Fix both ranges with $ signs and point the criteria at the region cell (E2), so the same formula works on every row. In F5, add the three region totals with SUM.
hints: SUMIF has three parts: =SUMIF(where to look, what to match, what to add up).
Look in the Region column (B2:B11), match the region in E2, and add the Sales column (C2:C11). Add $ signs so those two ranges stay fixed when you copy the formula down.
For F5, use =SUM(F2:F4) to add the three totals. The region names may be in lower case in the list; SUMIF ignores case.
